pv_model.source: v3/integrate/energy/v3_energy.py (read-only import), set LID2+WR31 with the lid strips at 2.30 mm; Voc slope -6.96 mV/K per string (KXOB25-03X4TF p.1 via V3)

V_O2_at_check.note: V_O2 = PV node at a 20 uA load (Q14 off) - 0.24 V (BAT54CM VF max at 0.1 mA, p.4; at 20 uA it is lower) - Q18 at uA (negligible)

threshold_design.rule: every corner: cold stop >= 0.5 C and hot stop <= 44.5 C (0.5 K margin to the cell's 0-45 C charge window, GEB301030 via BASELINE 5.2)

o2_load_from_pv.when: only while VBAT_OK is low (MCU off) and the PV is lit: Q18 is off while VBAT_OK is high

dark_load_uW.why: in the dark PV_SW = 0 V: no O-2 supply; VBAT_OK only drives the gates of Q16 and Q18 (no DC current); NTC_EN is driven only for an MCU reading (15 uA x 1.86 V for about 50 ms per reading = 0.8 nA average at one reading a minute)

normal_operation_cost.note: MCU on: Q16 holds O2_G at 0 V, so R174 draws PV_SW / 10 MOhm from the PV (0.2 uA, 0.4 uW of harvest); the O-2 itself is unpowered (Q18 off). Q14 adds its RDSon to R_LIM: 0.42-0.645 Ohm at VGS -2.5 V, 0.52-0.94 Ohm at -1.8 V (PMZ350UPE p.6)

approval_light_mcu_off.rule: V_O2 >= 1.65 V (TLV7031 1.6 V minimum + 50 mV) with the O-2's own load drawn from the PV at 25 C
approval_light_mcu_off.consequence: with the MCU off (dead or flat band) PV charging resumes only above this light; normal operation (MCU on) is not affected (Q16)

timing.Q14_turn_on_note: Q17 sinks >= 5 mA at VGS 1.8 V (PMZ290 RDSon <= 0.68 Ohm at 1.8 V), C174 100 nF discharged from 2 V
timing.hold_note: when the O-2 browns out after approving (V_O2 < 1.6 V at the MPP or at the cold-start clamp), C174 keeps Q14 on for the hold time, then Q14 opens, PV_SW returns to Voc and the O-2 re-checks within about 0.3-1 ms: harvest duty >= 99 %; out of range, Q14 stays off
timing.gate_leakage_note: PMZ350UPE IGSS <= 10 uA at +-8 V (ESD diodes, p.6); at 2 V it is not specified: with 20 nA the hold shortens by about 10 % (assumption)

cell_states.method: the decision is taken with Q14 OFF, so the O-2 is supplied by the open-circuit PV (rows of V_O2_at_check) and does not depend on the cell: 0 / 0.5 / 1.2 / 2.0 V cells, a tripped PCM and a healthy flat cell give the same decision supply
paths_into_cell_with_Q14_off: none: PV_SW reaches the cell only through Q14 - R130 - BQ25570; R126 (EN_HOLD), Q18/D19 (V_O2), U4 IN- and D8 end at GND
Q14 off-state leakage IDSS <= 1 uA at -20 V, 25 C (PMZ350UPE p.6): at VDS 2-3 V and 50 C it is assumed <= 1 uA, i.e. < 0.00002 C
cell_states.after_approval: cell 0-1.6 V: VSTOR < 1.73 V so the BQ25570 cold-starts (VIN_DC clamped at 0.6 V, SLUSBH2G p.18) or the three-diode path conducts at high light; V_O2 may fall below 1.6 V, then the hold of section 4 applies (re-check every 0.1-1.0 s); healthy flat cell: MPP at 0.8 Voc
cell_states.out_of_range: Q14 stays off: no PV current into the cell in any state (criterion of V3-G4)

ts_window.note: while VBUS is present Q8 shorts PV_SW, D19A blocks, so the ladder hangs on the NTC node only through R116 + (chain || U19 supply pin); the MCU is awake (VBUS wakes it through D12A) and NTC_EN is not driven while /PG is low (firmware rule, BASELINE 14 item 10). Q10 off: IDSS <= 1 uA at 20 V (PMZ290), nA at 1 V.
ts_window.criterion: cold stop >= 0 C and hot stop <= 45 C at every corner (BASELINE 12, 13.2)
ts_window.v3_arch_reference: V3_ARCH 7.4: 1.9-6.0 C / 38.8-44.8 C with the TS bias alone

mcu_reading.path: NTC_EN (P0.30) high -> D19B -> V_O2 -> R116 -> NTC; P0.28 reads the NTC node through R149 1 MOhm with C113 10 nF at the pin (tau 10 ms)
mcu_reading.note: VF of D19B is the main error (BAT54CM 240-320 mV max at 0.1-1 mA, p.4); firmware corrects VF with the board temperature (TMP117); the hardware O-2 is ratiometric and does not depend on it. While VBUS is present the MCU reads the TS bias instead (38 uA x R_ntc), as V3-R.
mcu_reading.ain_leak_note: MCU unpowered (the O-2 case): the AIN ESD diode can conduct once the NTC node exceeds about 0.4 V; through R149 1 MOhm that is <= 0.2 uA at 0.6 V (about 0 C at V_O2 2 V) against a ladder current of 15 uA: < 0.5 K, in the 'reads colder' direction below 0 C only beyond -10 C

no_oscillation.Q1: Q1 (PV_INH) can only be on while the MCU runs (R108 10 MOhm pull-down): then VBAT_OK is high and Q18 keeps the O-2 unpowered: no loop (S1: Q16 follows the heartbeat)
no_oscillation.Q8: Q8 shorts PV_SW while VBUS is present: V_O2 collapses, U19/U20 go to POR (outputs low), Q17 releases, Q14 opens after the hold (or stays on via Q16): no PV current either way; when VBUS goes away PV_SW rises with Q14 off and the O-2 decides at Voc
no_oscillation.own_action: the O-2 opens Q14 (it never shorts the PV), so tripping RAISES its own supply to Voc: the decision state is self-consistent

hysteresis_K.note: internal hysteresis 2/7/17 mV (typ 7 mV) at V_O2 2.0 V, in kelvin at each threshold

no_oscillation.supply_ratiometric: ladder and chain hang on the same V_O2: a supply step (Q14 switching moves PV_SW between Voc and the MPP) does not move the trip ratio; C170 100 nF filters the BQ25570's 16 s Voc-sampling step and the boost ripple

D15_margin_K.rule: no PV current outside 0-45 C: cold stop >= 0 C, hot stop <= 45 C at every corner (the lane's 0.5 K design margin is not met at 1.6 V)

D1_heartbeat.circuit: CHG_DIS (P0.09) -> C175 220 pF C0G -> O2_HB = Q16 gate; R176 1 MOhm to GND; Q16 drain on O2_G (C174 100 nF / R174 10 MOhm hold of Q14)
D1_heartbeat.Q16_needs: >= 1.0 V for a few us: PMZ290UNE2 VGSth 0.45-0.95 V at 250 uA (p.6); C174 needs only 30-300 nC per pulse (Q16 sinks mA)
D1_heartbeat.static_level: a static CHG_DIS level decays through R176 in 5 tau = 1.3 ms: no override from a stuck pin

release_after_last_pulse_s.note: Q14 opens when |VGS| decays below its threshold: the stage-0 'fault response' of the O-2 hold

cost_uW_E.note: E: one 15 us CPU wake per pulse (about 55 nC at 3.7 mA) and the C174 top-up at PV_SW 2.5 V; only while the firmware wants PV charging

states.mcu_running_heartbeat: Q16 refreshes the hold: Q14 on, the firmware governor (Q1 PV_INH + NTC reading + heartbeat stop) keeps 0-45 C
states.vbat_ok_high_no_heartbeat: Q16 off and Q18 off (O-2 unpowered): Q14 off within the hold: no PV charging (reset, boot loop, halt, System OFF, power cycle)
states.vbat_ok_low: buck and MCU off (VOUT_EN = VBAT_OK through R129): Q18 feeds the O-2 from the PV; the window comparators decide (stage 0 behaviour)

firmware_rules: pulse CHG_DIS only in software (never PPI, a timer or PWM), 10 us at 10 Hz
only while CHG_PG_N is high (no head) and the last NTC reading is inside 0-45 C (0.5 K margin); stop on any out-of-window reading
never during an NTC reading (Q10 pulls the NTC node low for 10 us)
SHELF in System OFF does not harvest with a healthy cell; below VBAT_OK falling (3.31 V) the O-2 takes over (>= 711 lx)

D4_hot_stop_with_NTC_EN_high_C.rule: firmware: never drive NTC_EN while CHG_PG_N is low; ignore NTC_ADC while /PG is low (BASELINE 14 item 10, S1 D-4)

D11_cold_start_Q14_Vth_max.note: Q14's gate sits at GND after an approval, so |VGS| = PV_SW: Q14 passes the cold-start current while PV_SW >= the value above. With the MCU off nothing harvests below the approval light anyway (711 lx); above it the PV node holds >= 1.4 V at the combined load, so a max-threshold Q14 does not throttle the cold start further (E; SIM-03 (a) to confirm)
